name: Complex Transformation Disguise
description: Replaces the original register-swap mechanics with compositions of anti-holomorphic functions on the complex plane (conjugation and rotated conjugations). The transformations are carefully chosen such that applying any transformation twice yields the identity, but composing any two different transformations yields a non-identity rotation. This perfectly preserves the inequality constraint ($s_u \neq s_v$) while forcing the model to algebraically evaluate the compositions, defeating pattern matching on the original swap operations.
